environment.description: Same application deployed on the same EC2/ALB stack, but the ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL contains two rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) a custom rule with priority 0 that applies a rate-limit of 100 requests per 5 minutes per IP with action BLOCK, and (2) the AWS managed rule group 'AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet' at priority 1 with all rules in default action (BLOCK), which includes SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING (blocks query strings > 2048 bytes), NoUserAgent_HEADER, and CrossSiteScripting_QUERYSTRING/BODY rules. Additionally, a SEPARATE custom rule at priority 2 uses a regex pattern set matching on the QUERY_STRING component with the pattern `(?i)(?:union\s+select|;\s*(?:drop|alter|insert|update|delete)|'\s*or\s+'|'\s*--\s*)` with action BLOCK and text transformation URL_DECODE applied before matching.
